ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the fluke body with a sparse, stochastic distribution of high-intensity (white) point sources. Contrast ratio is extremely high between localized white spots and the uniform dark background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters are concentrated at the distal tips. Numerous isolated circular high-contrast nodes are scattered across both lobes, with a specific grouping of linear high-contrast pixels on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends significantly toward the peduncle connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitude is higher on the left lobe medial section compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex upward trajectory originating from the center and terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips pointing upwards.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of roughly circular high-intensity rings (3-8 pixel diameter) localized heavily on the distal tips and sporadically across the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel, high-contrast linear diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe; additional faint vertical parallel marks visible on the upper-inner section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the left lobe and a localized cluster of three parallel vertical scars on the right lobe; widespread circular scarring throughout.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme high-intensity pixel concentration at the distal tips creating a 'beaded' edge effect.
